page_title: MAL 1-0 RSO | Mallorca v Real Sociedad 17/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: Van Der Heyden S. Muscle Injury

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' The corner is swung in but Real Sociedad can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

90' Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the roof of the net, but Leo Roman is well positioned to make a comfortable save. The ball goes out of play. Real Sociedad are awarded a corner kick.
90' Real Sociedad take a short corner kick.
88' The referee signals a substitution. Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) is brought on as a substitute for Samu Costa.
88' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to substitute Sergi Darder and he is replaced by Valery (Mallorca).
88' Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) tricks his way to the edge of the box where he shoots at goal. The keeper scrambles to cover the effort, but it goes just wide of the left post.
85' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) has time on the edge of the box. His shot is disappointing, though, as it flies towards the middle of the goal where Leo Roman makes a comfortable save.
84' Flag up against Takuma Asano (Mallorca). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
81' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad).
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) comes onto the pitch for Ander Barrenetxea.
77' Flag goes up against Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
74' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes well wide of the right post.
73' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
71' Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) hits a first-time volley towards goal from outside the penalty area, but it is an easy save for the goalkeeper.
70' Jagoba Arrasate is forced to make a change. Robert Navarro (Mallorca) is unable to continue due to injury, Daniel Rodriguez comes on.

68' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Alex Remiro, who pulls off a comfortable save!
67' Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) is penalised for holding. Adrian Cordero Vega signals a set piece.
66' Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) fails to connect properly with the corner kick and plants his header way over the bar from the centre of the box.
66' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) will take the corner.
63' The manager makes a subsitution with Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) coming on for Abdon Prats.
63' Jagoba Arrasate decides to make a substitution. Cyle Larin will be replaced by Takuma Asano (Mallorca).
61' Substitution. Benat Turrientes makes way for Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad).
60' Substitution. Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Mikel Oyarzabal walks off.
60' That's the end of the game for Aritz Elustondo, who is replaced by Alvaro Odriozola (Real Sociedad).
60' Abdon Prats (Mallorca) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
58' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it well wide of the left post.
58' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) works the corner short.
57' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) has a goal ruled out for offside!
55' Abdon Prats (Mallorca) takes a first-time effort in order to beat the goalkeeper. Unfortunately for him, his shot sails just wide of the right post.
54' Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
54' Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
52' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) wins the ball in the box, but curls his effort well wide of the right post.
51' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
50' Real Sociedad take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
49' Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play and Real Sociedad manage to earn a corner.
47' The linesman signals that Cyle Larin (Mallorca) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
46' The attendance for today's match is 17132.
46' Imanol Alguacil has made a change at the break. Takefusa Kubo has come on in place of Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
42' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
41' A lofted cross from Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
40' Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Adrian Cordero Vega blows his whistle for a foul.
36' 1 - 0 Abdon Prats (Mallorca) makes no mistake from the penalty spot after waiting for Alex Remiro to move before rolling the ball into the middle of the goal!
36' Abdon Prats (Mallorca) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
35' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Mallorca!
34' Referee Adrian Cordero Vega makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Mallorca. Let’s see what happens!
33' That looked a certain handball by Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
32' Samu Costa (Mallorca) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
30' The free kick from long range, taken by Mallorca, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
27' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Mallorca.

27' Jose Copete (Mallorca) watches the corner all the way, but places his header a whisker wide of the left post from close range. The linesman points to the corner flag, Mallorca are going to take it.
26' Mallorca win a corner.
26' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
25' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and tries to catch the keeper out, but the shot lacks accuracy and curls well wide of the right post.
25' Foul! Jose Copete (Mallorca) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
24' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) commits a rough challenge and Adrian Cordero Vega blows his whistle for a foul.
24' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
21' Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper blocks the effort.
21' Mallorca have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
15' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Sergi Darder.
12' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but Alex Remiro has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
11' Samu Costa (Mallorca) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.

7' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) gets on the end of a pass and produces a promising first-time shot towards the right side of the goal. His effort is blocked by Leo Roman with a brilliant diving save!
6' Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) makes a good run into the box and unleashes a powerful header in the centre of the box from the corner, but it rises well over the bar.
6' Mallorca force their opponents to concede a corner.
6' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
5' Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Adrian Cordero Vega blows his whistle for a foul. Mallorca earn a free kick.
2' A snap shot by Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) from the edge of the area flies towards the left side of the goal, but Leo Roman produces a good save to thwart him.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Mallorca will take the kick-off.
Adrian Cordero Vega got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
